//: Typecheck-only config for the Playwright suite. Playwright transpiles the
//1: TypeScript itself at run time and never reads this file's emit settings, so
//2: `npm run typecheck` is the only consumer -- hence `noEmit`.
//3: `module: CommonJS` is not arbitrary: e2e/package.json deliberately omits
//4: `type: module` so Playwright's loader emits CJS and `__dirname` resolves in
//5: stack.ts. Declaring ESM here would typecheck a module system the suite does
//6: not actually run under, so a `__dirname` error would appear only at run time.
